audit.why: Thresh out-threats squishy, dash-less Senna every stage; chart already agrees full/content, 7/10-8/10 favoured throughout.
Level 2 hook all-in, Level 6 Box vs global-only R, and first item burst are the stated spikes and match both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Senna's root (Last Embrace) is repeatedly labeled her Q. Per the kit, Q is Piercing Darkness (the poke/heal beam, 600 range, 15s cd); W is Last Embrace (the root, 1250 range, 11s cd). whys[1], spikes[0].text, and wants.foe[0] all call the root "Q".
audit.why: Riot's kit data confirms slot order P/Q/W/E/R = Absolution/Piercing Darkness/Last Embrace/Curse of the Black Mist/Dawning Shadow.
audit.corrected: Relabel the root as W (Last Embrace) everywhere it is called Q; leave Q references to the poke/heal beam alone.

edits.before: At 2 your hook all-in beats her slow, telegraphed Q root.
edits.after: At 2 your hook all-in beats her slow, telegraphed W root.

edits.before: You spike at 2 with a real all-in threat while Senna has none: her Last Embrace (Q) is a slow, delayed root that only locks if it hits a target near your ADC, so you can sidestep it and then land Death Sentence into Flay-ignite. She's fragile early and can't answer a committed hook.
edits.after: You spike at 2 with a real all-in threat while Senna has none: her Last Embrace (W) is a slow, delayed root that only locks if it hits a target near your ADC, so you can sidestep it and then land Death Sentence into Flay-ignite. She's fragile early and can't answer a committed hook.

edits.before: Root your ADC with Q from max range to poke safely
edits.after: Root your ADC with W (Last Embrace) at max range

edits.before: - Senna Last Embrace (Root): matchup-defining — The root spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions and carry. It writes your spacing rules. - W Dark Passage is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Senna's Last Embrace (W): 11s cooldown — the root spreads to nearby targets, so stand off your own minions and carry and punish the whiff. - Your lantern (W) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - Your Box (R) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Hook the gap, flay the landing, lantern the collapse — the full sentence pays the whole team.
edits.after: Senna's poke sits at 600 range against your Flay's 500 sweep — close with E's knockback before Piercing Darkness resets at 15s and she resets the gap.

edits.before: Fishing predictably while the souls walk past — the collection IS the scaling; greed the hooks, not the chips.
edits.after: Piercing Darkness (Q) heals her ADC every 15s — chip autos just feed that sustain, so commit full all-ins instead of trading pokes.
